item.title: Cesar Brod: keynote confirmed at Python Sul 2025
item.description:
Hey folks! We’re thrilled to announce the third confirmed keynote for Python Sul 2025: Cesar Brod!

Cesar brings together technical expertise, passion for open source, and a deep commitment to community. Grab your mate, because stories and inspiration are on the way!

He’s a grandfather, nerd, writer, and CTO at Quaza Tecnologia. Cesar has been working in IT since 1982, with much of his professional background developed in the United States, Canada, and France. He started working with Linux in 1993 and, since 1997, through BrodTec, has provided consulting services, project management, and business models built on open source software.

item.title: Hisham H. Muhammad: keynote confirmed at Python Sul 2025
item.description:
Hey folks! Another big name is confirmed as a keynote speaker at Python Sul 2025!

We’re excited to announce that Hisham H. Muhammad is the second keynote of the event. Get your mate ready, because great things are coming!

If you’ve ever used Linux, chances are you’ve come across htop, that interactive process viewer that turns the command line into something almost poetic. It was created by Hisham H. Muhammad, who is also the author of LuaRocks, the package manager for Lua, and one of the founders of GoboLinux, a Linux distribution that redefines the operating system’s directory structure.

item.title: Bruna Ferreira (bug_elseif) will be a keynote at Python Sul 2025
item.description:
Exciting news!

We already have our first keynote confirmed, and it’s none other than the amazing and talented Bruna Ferreira.
PS: You might know her better by her handle bug_elseif, right?

Who is Bruna Ferreira?

Bruna is a software developer and DevX at BotCity. We already know her for her work as a content creator and as an active voice in the Python community. For all these reasons, she’s the perfect choice for our keynote.
